card.name: Digits of temperatures before degree sign
card.fires_on: A digit inside a temperature value in climate or science text, right before a degree sign such as °C or °F. It fires on the last digit or a middle digit of the number.

modes.description: Digits of average or seasonal temperatures just before °C.

card.writes: It promotes the degree sign ' °' and suppresses the word-like ' deg', so it pushes toward writing a degree symbol after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of a temperature reading when a degree sign is about to follow.
